review_evidence: Reviewed all 20 primary Lean files. Heights develops arithmetic height theory, absolute values/completions/equivalence, number-field and rational/projective results, with substantial lemma/theorem content across the main tree.

Potentially suspicious names were inspected conservatively: Heights/Scratch.lean and Heights/Graveyard.lean contain substantive mathematical definitions/lemmas/theorems, while Heights/Test.lean contains extensive experimental mathematical definitions and theorem/proof text separated by #exit markers. These remain useful formal prior art and are retained rather than filtered by filename or compilation status.
The root import/navigation surface is retained; no content-level lossless primary exclusion was established.
summary: Reviewed Heights and retained the complete arithmetic-height development, including substantive scratch/archive/test formal material.
